name: Ableton Live (AbletonOSC)
hint: play, stop, stop all, scene N, or track/clip (for example 2/0). Needs the AbletonOSC add-on running in Live; indexes count the way AbletonOSC counts them

rules.source: the AbletonOSC README (github.com/ideoforms/AbletonOSC) lists /live/song/stop_all_clips with no arguments
the AbletonOSC README lists /live/song/start_playing with no arguments
the AbletonOSC README lists /live/song/stop_playing with no arguments
the AbletonOSC README lists /live/scene/fire with one argument, scene_id
the AbletonOSC README lists /live/clip/fire with arguments track_id and clip_id; whether counting starts at 0 or 1 was not read: check on a real Live set
